summary: Core practical reweighting fails on admissible signed cosine costs (Major); manual-audit row10 is false at a=0,b=1 (Minor). Unconstrained transport remains valid; historical score effects unknown.

problems.title: Zero multiplicative mask fails for signed cosine costs

claim.text: Practical reweighting masks overly large weights to limit further selection.

problems.check: Exact rational scalar recurrence and unit-embedding argument; source image and static release inspection.
problems.result: Printed and independently translated release rule both return[8,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]; masked item continues to win.
counterevidence: Positive cosine among eligible alternatives is a favorable regime.
Release normalization and >=threshold differ but do not cure this example.

impact.affected: The concentration-control component of the central reweighting routine can leave all matching mass on one conjecture and continue selecting it after masking.
impact.not_established: No historical instability or benchmark damage; no invalid unconstrained transport theorem.

correction.text: Hard exclusion and preassignment cap yield[3,3,2,0,0,0,0,0] here; no general greedy-capacity optimality established.

problems.severity_rationale: Major: admissible signed cosines leave all mass on one item and continue selecting it after capping, defeating the core concentration-control mechanism; semantic-topic loss is not independently demonstrated.

acceptance_check.scope: Unconstrained transport solution remains valid; historical signs, instability and score effects unknown.
